headline: 3 issues to be analyzed along with the minimum wage increase for 2027
summary: Conasami will analyze three issues alongside the 2027 minimum wage increase: continuity of the MIR, a possible reduction of professional salary categories, and a differentiated adjustment for the northern border.
why: Minimum wage decisions affect labor costs for employers and wage levels across Mexico's economy.
original_headline: 3 temas que se analizarán junto con el incremento al salario mínimo para el 2027
